statement: A slug MUST NOT be able to contain a glob metacharacter.
input_text: Which *.md files should the [0-9] matcher pick up?
note: The question text contains `*`, `.`, `[`, `]` and `?` -- every metacharacter the REC-067 lookup glob is built from. Because REC-058 restricts output to [a-z0-9-], NONE of them can survive into the slug. This is the property REC-068's pattern construction relies on: if a slug could smuggle a `*` into the glob, the anchored digit-class pattern would be defeated from the other end.
